title: Ehrhart Polynomials for Lattice Polytopes
description: Formalizes Ehrhart's theorem (1962): for a d-dimensional convex lattice polytope P, L_P(n) = |nP ∩ ℤᵈ| is a polynomial of degree d in n. Proves coefficient interpretations, Pick's theorem recovery in 2D, unit simplex formula L_Δ(n) = C(n+d,d), Reeve tetrahedra analysis, and Ehrhart-Macdonald reciprocity. 3 axioms for the main Ehrhart polynomial theorem. 25 theorems.

overview.historicalContext: Ehrhart (1962) proved L_P(n) is a polynomial. This generalizes Pick's theorem to higher dimensions.
overview.problemStatement: Formalize Ehrhart polynomials, their properties, and the connection to Pick's theorem.
overview.proofStrategy: Define Ehrhart counting function; axiomatize polynomial existence; prove Pick's recovery in 2D and unit simplex formula.
